slowest_experiments.experiment: Three-family semantic contrast scoring stream v2

summary: The milestone completed 9 experiments in 5.0 minutes, including 3 compute-bound experiments. The compute-bound leaders were Tokenizer-aware semantic contrast preregistration v2 at 2.35 minutes, followed by Canonical tokenizer binding requalification and Three-family semantic contrast scoring stream v2 at 0.86 minutes each. No data available this milestone explains their phase costs.
bottlenecks_identified: Disk-mtime reconstruction replaced live commit timing, so task-phase attribution is unavailable.
No data available this milestone explains why Tokenizer-aware semantic contrast preregistration v2 was the longest compute-bound entry.
The GPU report is not tied to compute-task execution windows, and no data available this milestone records parallel model count or runner selection.
improvements_suggested: Record monotonic start, end, and phase timestamps for every experiment instead of relying only on disk modification times.
Attach task-window GPU utilization samples and process identity to every compute-bound artifact.
Record model count and runner selection at launch, and select DualGPURunner only when two or more models are loaded in parallel.
Allow the scheduler to overlap independent synthesis-only work with compute-bound work when dependencies permit.
top_3_highest_leverage_actions: Add task-scoped phase and GPU telemetry to the conductor artifact contract.
Add model-count and runner-selection receipts to each compute launch.
Overlap dependency-free synthesis-only work with active compute jobs.
meta_reflection: The bounded record identifies the longest entries but does not expose their internal phases or task-window accelerator use. The next retrospective should use per-task telemetry instead of inferring execution behavior from modification times and a terminal GPU snapshot.
